summary: Q1 2026 reported April 29, 2026. Revenue $56.3B (+33% YoY, beat $55.5B est), EPS $7.31 adj (+14%, beat $6.79 est), ARPP $15.66 (beat $15.26 est). Stock dropped ~10% post-earnings on capex raise ($125-145B) and decelerating Q2 guidance (~23% CC growth vs 29% prior). Q2 2026 earnings expected late July 2026 (date not yet confirmed).
